definition: Per-team count and quality-weighted sum of DNP and Limited players by unit (offense, defense, special teams) from the official weekly report, plus confirmed game-status Out/Questionable changes across reporting days.
observed_example: Week 10 2026 snapshot: IND 7 DNPs incl. two DTs; MIN 6 DNPs incl. two QBs; NE 12 limited

definition: When a starter is out, measure the quality gap between the absent starter and the replacing 2nd/3rd/4th-string player, using official roster status and club announcements. Requires a depth-order source — NFL.com does not publish depth order (IR-023).
data_needed: Official roster status; club depth announcements; snap/participation data (source TBD — Q9)
observed_example: Week 10 snapshot: IND DTs Stewart + Tillery DNP; DET secondary Joseph + Reed Out

definition: Team and player efficiency from official tracking-derived Next Gen Stats metrics (e.g., completion-air metrics, separation, speed) and official team stat tables.
data_needed: NFL.com stats + NGS pages (verified live); historical archive for backtesting
observed_example: NGS Week 10 charts live (route/carry/pass charts for all Week 10 games)

definition: Short-week, international-game and time-zone spots computed from the official captured schedule rows (e.g., Week 1 Melbourne game, Week 11 Mexico City game, post-by-week spots).
data_needed: data/official/events.json NFL rows (captured from official by-week pages)
observed_example: MIN@SF Mexico City Nov 22 (8:20 PM ET) and W10 TNF short-week spots exist in the captured rows

definition: Identify lineup-changing transactions (trades, reserve-list moves) inside the weekly window; a newly traded starter or a reserve-list demotion changes unit quality before the next game.
data_needed: Official transactions page (verified live; November 2026 trades listed)
observed_example: 12 trades Nov 6–10, 2026 incl. Kirk Cousins LV→MIN and Keenan Allen IND→SF

definition: Benchmark every graded bet against the closing line; strategies are scored on CLV to remove luck. Requires a licensed odds source — no official NFL source publishes odds (IR-025); blocked on owner decision Q2.

Track game-status changes between the first reporting day and the final report (Questionable→Out or Out→Active swings) as a within-week signal; requires capturing the report every reporting day, not once.
data_needed: Daily capture of the official injury report

definition: Bye-week returns, prime-time spots and motivational/context edges derived only from officially anchored dates (important-dates calendar, official schedule).
observed_example: NFL important-dates anchors already captured in the repo (playoffs, SB LXI Feb 14 2027)
